chapters.caption: 1. Choose MySolArk. Run PAP will read real solar power, load and battery voltage.
2. Run PAP. This is a new request. The waiting time is shown in real time.
3. The output: 0.622 kW additional in the first interval, 2.222 kWh across 12 hours, low confidence.
4. Each bar covers one hour. kW is modeled power headroom. The kWh total adds the energy available across all twelve hours.
5. Zero means the model allocates no extra solar power in that interval. The total is spread across the forecast, not available all at once.
6. Read the agent guidance and calculation assumptions. Weather is synthetic and battery discharge is zero. The operator decides what to do.
7. Valid means publication checks passed. Confidence is a qualitative label. PAP never switches equipment on or off.
8. Inspector follows this run. Trace shows workflow order. Health checks the current service.
9. Subagent shows the actual local model calls. Use Forecast in the navigation to return to the same output.

audio: Silent. Captions explain the output; add your narration if desired.
